patterns: APPSC asks Nobel basics: Nobel invented dynamite, Einstein's Nobel = photoelectric effect, first Indian Nobel (Tagore) and statement items on Indian-origin laureates (Khorana shared, Raman alone).
Bhatnagar Prize = science, given by CSIR; APPSC once asked a specific year's awardee (2010).
'Nobel equivalent' items recur: Fields Medal (mathematics), International Prize in Statistics (C.R. Rao).
Chandrasekhar = white dwarf limit / 'black hole' principle; Raman 1930 date questions are common in other PSCs.
App MCQs track these well but add 2024-26 items (RVP categories, Wolf Prize 2026, Nobel status rule) beyond PYQ depth; many PYQs filed here are sports/Padma/mental-ability strays.
